selected_records.title: "Train classical, deploy quantum" requires rethinking generalization

article.body:
ArXiv Record Suggests Quantum Deployment Needs Rethinking

A 31 August 2026 ArXiv cs.LG record titled "Train classical, deploy quantum" offers no evidence of a tested or operational quantum capability. The record, which does not provide an abstract, findings or supporting evidence, does not establish a policy decision or action. No affected public body, military service or supplier is identified in the record. The title suggests a need for rethinking generalization in the field of quantum computing, but does not specify what was trained, deployed or demonstrated.
